description:
Are you a front end developer looking for the next challenge? Do you like working in an environment where your work will be noticed throughout the organization?
 A small team within a recently launched and growing company is looking for a Front End Developer that will own the team's main UIs from start to finish. An option to extend to full-stack/server-side development (Java/Python) also is available.
 This is a completely greenfield opportunity and the work is highly visible throughout the entire company. The main UI will be used throughout the business to display real-time and End-Of-Day pricing from multiple data sources, and will allow for defining the transformation rules to be applied to the data.

 This opportunity might be for you if: 
 Have designed and built high-performance front-end applications.
 Have built real-time / streaming user interfaces.
 Like working a fast paced and growing company with little supervision.
 Like being in an environment where your work will be noticed.
 To land this opportunity you should have: 
 History of successfully delivering software projects.
 3+ years' experience in front end development.
 JavaScript/HTML5 experience using React / Redux for building real-time / streaming UIs is desirable.
 Financial industry experience nice to have but not required. There is an expectations to mentor to get up to speed with domain knowledge.
  
 Interested? We should talk.
 (All communication is kept confidential, of course)

 In addition to competitive compensation package (base salary + bonus) a full benefit package is offered including medical, dental, vision, life, and retirement. 
  
 Interested candidates should send their resumes to: 
 jobs (at) alphanexusgroup (dot) com 
  
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
